### Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes.

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds AST/language capability)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing tests to fail)
- [ ] Documentation update

### Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the Siber Akademi T-Zero code style and zero-leak security guardrails.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All 105 unit tests pass (`python -m unittest discover tests -v`).
